headline: Buy a one-year compute savings plan for the order platform
classLine: This needs two people, each on their own. You are one of them, and you will not see the other answer until you have given yours.
summary: USD 25.00 an hour for one year, USD 219,000 in total, about €205,860 at 0.94 euro to the dollar. Paid monthly, about €17,155 a month as invoiced, which follows the exchange rate. It cannot be cancelled, refunded or exchanged, and each hour's benefit is lost if it is not used.
browserNote: Opens in your browser. If Teams opens it in its own view and your passkey or security key is not accepted, use the link in the e-mail I sent.
